notes: Web splits (SL) are real geometry: a slot through the web, drawn in NEST and cut through the part in CONTROL, selectable and double-clickable into the split tool. A split is now just a start and an end - CONTROL splits it at its own cutting windows and puts the bridges in, so the tabs always land where the windows do. Rips get their own bridge (25 mm / 1 inch) separate from the long-cut split bridge, and a rip that would cut a part loose with no bridge says so. A file arriving with its own SL segments collapses to one continuous rip. Bandsaw mode (DEV tab): pick a section, type lengths and quantities, and the parts are nested into bars of the length you actually have - common cuts throughout - written as a small job you can re-open, adjust or re-nest in NEST. LOAD now filters projects by customer, with a search over name, number and customer. New setting: cut the first part's end cut before anything else, so a position error costs one cut instead of a bar of holes (off by default). Settings dialog: Cancel restores the robot pose it was showing. SEND pulses from the moment it is pressed and cannot be left pulsing at nothing. KCL console commands no longer wait out a 6 second timeout each - Clear Progs and SEND finish in about two seconds.
